== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Hoth Survival Gear (Japanese ESB Two-Player)|Hoth Survival Gear]] from [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://theswca.com/index.php?action=disp_item&item_id=100683 Star Wars Collectors Archive item 100683], [https://theswca.com/imgup/100683-1.jpg source photograph].

Crop rectangle <code>(90, 50, 680, 930)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>8ce20813a526898e73c5fdb4d9e04b6e2d27d3fb0423acdbf39c0a352266ff99</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1998.
